definitions: Evaluations performed by Turnitin software to detect plagiarism or AI-generated content in submitted academic work.
Reports generated by Turnitin indicating the originality of a document and highlighting potential instances of unoriginal content.
examples: The professor reviewed the Turnitin Checks for all essays.
Students must submit their papers for Turnitin Checks before the deadline.
The Turnitin Checks revealed a high similarity score.
